propositions: Mapped project keys are validated as visible to the bridge bot before any reconcile mutation, preventing decommissioned or permission-lost projects from causing late ACLI errors in fan-out
legacy_default destination is included in preflight visibility check to prevent unbound/legacy tickets from creating mass writes into wrong or nonexistent projects
When projects mapping is empty, the configured query_project fallback is included in visibility validation via the same single source of truth
Preflight runs strictly before reconcile_once only for mutating passes (skipping preview, dry-run, and reconcile-check routes)
Transport probe reuses AcliClient._direct_rest_get against Jira Cloud GET /rest/api/3/project/search endpoint with pagination and hard fail-closed on page-cap exhaustion
Preflight gates on configured backend being 'jira' and gracefully skips for non-Cloud backends or clients lacking _direct_rest_get capability
